title: Docs generating confused combinations of enums/constants
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.6.stable, 4.5.1.stable

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS 24.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon 760M Graphics (radeonsi, phoenix, LLVM 20.1.2, DRM 3.57, 6.8.0-100-generic) - AMD Ryzen 5 7640U w/ Radeon 760M Graphics (12 threads) - 13.45 GiB memory

### Issue description

After changing an enum from private to public, I noticed that the docs broke, listing an impossible combination mixed of enums and constants. I tried to reduce it as much as possible while still preserving the bug.

The code has
- one public enum
- two private enums
- three private constants (1 array and 2 dictionaries, each using an enum)

As it is, the docs should only list the single public enum. Turn out, it also list three other "enums" (that aren't even real enums):
- first one has the name of a private enum, and its values are the first dictionary...
- second one has the name of the public enum but as an array (???) as name, and its values are the private array
- third one has the name of the other private enum, and its values are the second dictionary...

I don't know what's going on here but clearly, this is all messed up.

Just in case it's needed, here's what the docs look like:
```
Class:   NewScript
Inherits:   Node <   Object

  There is currently no description for this class.

Enumerations

enum Power:

● ONE = 0
● TWO = 1
● FOUR = 2
● EIGHT = 3

enum _Si:

● _SI_COLOR = Dictionary[int, Color]({0: Color(0, 0, 0, 1), 1: Color(0.74509805, 0.74509805, 0.74509805, 1), 2: Color(1, 1, 1, 1)})

enum Power[]:

● _STATIC_POWERS = Array[int]([0])

enum _Aim:

● _AIM_POSITION = Dictionary[int, Vector2]({0: Vector2(1, 1), 1: Vector2(0, -1)})


```

### Steps to reproduce

```python
class_name NewScript

enum Power {
	ONE,
	TWO,
	FOUR,
	EIGHT,
}

enum _Aim {
	FORWARD,
	UP,
}
enum _Si {
	BLACK,
	GRAY,
	WHITE,
}

const _SI_COLOR: Dictionary[_Si, Color] = {
	_Si.BLACK: Color.BLACK,
	_Si.GRAY: Color.GRAY,
	_Si.WHITE: Color.WHITE,
}
const _STATIC_POWERS: Array[Power] = [
	Power.ONE,
]
const _AIM_POSITION: Dictionary[_Aim, Vector2] = {
	_Aim.FORWARD: Vector2.ONE,
	_Aim.UP: Vector2.UP,
}
```
